fullPassage: Agritourism is an increasingly popular form of travel that allows tourists to experience rural life, connect with nature, and learn about the agricultural industry. It provides tourists with an amazing experience and a fun educational opportunity they cannot have in cities. It also gives valuable insights into the history and culture of farming and the importance of sustainable agriculture. Most tourists spend time visiting farm stands, picking fruit, or feeding animals. Others may navigate a corn maze, stay on a farm, or help with farm chores. In addition to providing fun activities for tourists, agritourism has become a necessary means of survival for many small farms today. This is because agritourism activities can take place at times of the year when crops are not in season. By adding new business operations, farm operators are able to ensure a stable income regardless of the seasons. Some studies have found that agritourism operations also benefit the surrounding communities by attracting tourists to the area. The economic boost from increased traffic can be good for the entire rural community.

questions.passage: Agritourism is an increasingly popular form of travel that allows tourists to experience rural life, connect with nature, and learn about the (A)[agricultural / industrial] industry. It provides tourists with an amazing experience and a fun (B)[educational / destructive] opportunity they cannot have in cities. It also gives (C)[valuable / worthless] insights into the history and culture of farming.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 농업(agricultural) 산업에 대해 배우고, 재미있는 교육적(educational) 기회를 제공하며, 귀중한(valuable) 통찰력을 준다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① agricultural — educational — valuable: 원문 일치
❌ ② industrial(산업의): agricultural(농업의)과 다른 분야. 농촌 체험 관광 맥락에 부적합
❌ ③ destructive(파괴적인): educational(교육적인)의 반의어 맥락
❌ ④ worthless(무가치한): valuable의 반의어
det.tip: agricultural(농업의) ↔ industrial(산업의), educational(교육적) ↔ destructive(파괴적), valuable(귀중한) ↔ worthless(무가치한)

questions.passage: In addition to providing fun activities for tourists, agritourism has become a (A)[necessary / unnecessary] means of survival for many small farms today. This is because agritourism activities can take place at times of the year when crops are not in season. By adding new business operations, farm operators are able to ensure a (B)[stable / unstable] income (C)[regardless / because] of the seasons.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 농촌 체험 관광은 필수적인(necessary) 생존 수단이 되었고, 농장 운영자들은 계절에 관계없이(regardless) 안정적인(stable) 수입을 보장한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ necessary — stable — regardless: 원문 일치
❌ ① unnecessary(불필요한): 생존 수단으로 '불필요'는 모순
❌ ② unstable(불안정한): 안정적 수입 보장 맥락과 반대
❌ ④ because(때문에): regardless of(~에 관계없이)가 원문. '계절 때문에'는 의미 반대
det.tip: regardless of(~에 관계없이) ↔ because of(~때문에). necessary(필수적) ↔ unnecessary(불필요한)

questions.passage: Some studies have found that agritourism operations also (A)[benefit / harm] the surrounding communities by (B)[attracting / repelling] tourists to the area. The economic (C)[boost / decline] from increased traffic can be good for the entire rural community.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 주변 지역사회에 이익을 준다(benefit). 관광객을 유치하여(attracting) 경제적 활성화(boost)를 가져온다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② benefit — attracting — boost: 원문 일치
❌ ① harm(해를 끼치다): benefit의 반의어. 이점을 설명하는 맥락
❌ ③ repelling(쫓아내는): attracting의 반의어. 관광객 유치 맥락과 모순
❌ ④ decline(감소): boost의 반의어. 경제적 활성화 맥락
det.tip: benefit(이익을 주다) ↔ harm(해를 끼치다), attract(끌어들이다) ↔ repel(쫓아내다), boost(활성화) ↔ decline(감소)

questions.passage: Agritourism is an increasingly popular form of travel that allows tourists to experience rural life, connect with nature, and learn about the agricultural industry. It provides tourists with an ①<u>amazing</u> experience and a fun educational opportunity they cannot have in cities. It also gives ②<u>valuable</u> insights into the history and culture of farming and the importance of ③<u>sustainable</u> agriculture. Most tourists spend time visiting farm stands, picking fruit, or ④<u>starving</u> animals.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ④ starving → feeding: 원문은 'feeding animals'(동물에게 먹이 주기). starving(굶주리게 하다)은 농장 체험 맥락과 정반대
❌ ① amazing: 원문 일치. 놀라운 경험
❌ ② valuable: 원문 일치. 귀중한 통찰
❌ ③ sustainable: 원문 일치. 지속 가능한 농업
det.tip: feeding(먹이를 주다) ↔ starving(굶주리게 하다). 농장 체험에서는 동물에게 먹이를 주는 활동

questions.passage: In addition to providing fun activities for tourists, agritourism has become a ①<u>necessary</u> means of survival for many small farms today. This is because agritourism activities can take place at times of the year when crops are not in season. By adding new business operations, farm operators are able to ensure a ②<u>stable</u> income ③<u>regardless</u> of the seasons. Some studies have found that agritourism operations also ④<u>damage</u> the surrounding communities by attracting tourists to the area.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ③ regardless: 원문 일치. 계절에 관계없이
❌ ① necessary: 원문 일치. 필수적인 생존 수단
❌ ② stable: 원문 일치. 안정적인 수입
✅ ④ damage → benefit: 원문은 'benefit the surrounding communities'. damage(피해를 주다)는 이익을 주는 맥락과 정반대
det.tip: benefit(이익을 주다) ↔ damage(피해를 주다). 농촌 관광의 긍정적 영향 맥락

questions.passage: Agritourism is an increasingly popular form of travel that allows tourists to experience rural life, connect with nature, and learn about the agricultural industry. It provides tourists with an amazing experience and a fun educational opportunity they cannot have in cities. It also gives valuable insights into the history and culture of farming and the importance of ①<u>sustainable</u> agriculture. Most tourists spend time visiting farm stands, picking fruit, or feeding animals. Others may ②<u>navigate</u> a corn maze, stay on a farm, or help with farm ③<u>chores</u>. In addition to providing fun activities for tourists, agritourism has become a necessary means of ④<u>extinction</u> for many small farms today.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ④ extinction → survival: 원문은 'a necessary means of survival'(필수적인 생존 수단). extinction(멸종, 소멸)은 정반대 의미. 소규모 농장이 살아남기 위한 수단
❌ ① sustainable: 원문 일치. 지속 가능한
❌ ② navigate: 원문 일치. (미로를) 탐험하다
❌ ③ chores: 원문 일치. (농장) 잡일
det.tip: survival(생존) ↔ extinction(멸종). means of survival = 생존 수단

questions.passage: Agritourism is an increasingly popular form of travel that allows tourists to experience rural life, connect with nature, and learn about the __________ industry. It provides tourists with an amazing experience and a fun educational opportunity they cannot have in cities. It also gives valuable insights into the history and culture of farming and the importance of sustainable agriculture. Most tourists spend time visiting farm stands, picking fruit, or feeding animals. Others may navigate a corn maze, stay on a farm, or help with farm chores.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ③ agricultural: 원문 일치. 농촌 체험 관광이므로 농업 산업
❌ ① manufacturing(제조업): 농촌과 무관
❌ ② technological(기술의): 농촌 체험과 무관
❌ ④ financial(금융의): 맥락과 무관
det.tip: agricultural(농업의) = 농사와 관련된. agritourism의 agri- = agriculture

questions.passage: Most tourists spend time visiting farm stands, picking fruit, or feeding animals. Others may navigate a corn maze, stay on a farm, or help with farm chores. In addition to providing fun activities for tourists, agritourism has become a necessary means of __________ for many small farms today. This is because agritourism activities can take place at times of the year when crops are not in season. By adding new business operations, farm operators are able to ensure a stable income regardless of the seasons.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ② survival: 원문 일치. 비수확기에도 수입을 확보하여 농장이 살아남을 수 있게 함
❌ ① entertainment(오락): 관광객 입장에서는 맞지만 농장의 '필수적 수단'과 부적합
❌ ③ competition(경쟁): 생존과 다른 맥락
❌ ④ decoration(장식): 맥락과 무관
det.tip: means of survival = 생존 수단. 소규모 농장이 계절에 관계없이 수입을 확보하는 방법

questions.passage: By adding new business operations, farm operators are able to ensure a stable income regardless of the seasons. Some studies have found that agritourism operations also benefit the surrounding communities by attracting tourists to the area. The economic __________ from increased traffic can be good for the entire rural community. Agritourism activities can take place at times of the year when crops are not in season. This is why agritourism has become a necessary means of survival for many small farms today.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① boost: 원문 일치. 관광객 유입으로 경제 활성화
❌ ② crisis(위기): 이익을 주는 맥락과 반대
❌ ③ burden(부담): 긍정적 영향 맥락과 반대
❌ ④ isolation(고립): 관광객 유치와 반대 개념
det.tip: economic boost = 경제적 활성화/부양. boost(증가, 활성화) ↔ decline(감소)

questions.passage: It provides tourists with an <u>amazing</u> experience and a fun educational opportunity they cannot have in cities.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 amazing과 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ② wonderful(훌륭한): amazing과 동의어
❌ ① boring(지루한): amazing의 반의어
❌ ③ ordinary(평범한): amazing의 반의어 맥락
❌ ④ tiring(피곤한): 경험의 질과 다른 의미
det.tip: amazing = wonderful = incredible(놀라운) ↔ boring = ordinary(평범한, 지루한)

questions.passage: By adding new business operations, farm operators are able to <u>ensure</u> a stable income regardless of the seasons.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ensure과 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ④ guarantee(보장하다): ensure과 동의어
❌ ① prevent(방지하다): 수입을 보장이 아닌 방지
❌ ② reduce(줄이다): 수입을 줄이는 것은 반대
❌ ③ risk(위험에 빠뜨리다): 보장의 반대
det.tip: ensure = guarantee = secure(보장하다) ↔ risk = jeopardize(위험에 빠뜨리다)

questions.passage: It also gives valuable <u>insights</u> into the history and culture of farming and the importance of sustainable agriculture.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 insights과 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① understandings(이해): insights와 동의어. 깊은 이해/통찰
❌ ② complaints(불만): 통찰과 무관
❌ ③ obstacles(장애물): 맥락과 무관
❌ ④ profits(이익): 금전적 이익은 통찰과 다름
det.tip: insights(통찰, 깊은 이해) = understandings = perceptions

questions.passage: By adding new business operations, farm operators are able to ensure a <u>stable</u> income regardless of the seasons.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 stable과 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ③ fluctuating(변동하는): stable의 반의어. 안정적 ↔ 변동하는
❌ ① steady(꾸준한): stable과 동의어
❌ ② reliable(믿을 수 있는): stable과 유사어
❌ ④ consistent(일관된): stable과 유사어
det.tip: stable = steady = consistent(안정적인) ↔ fluctuating = unstable(변동하는, 불안정한)

questions.passage: Agritourism is an <u>increasingly</u> popular form of travel that allows tourists to experience rural life, connect with nature, and learn about the agricultural industry.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 increasingly와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ② decreasingly(점점 줄어드는): increasingly의 반의어
❌ ① gradually(점차적으로): increasingly와 유사한 의미
❌ ③ significantly(상당히): 정도의 의미이지 방향이 아님
❌ ④ constantly(끊임없이): 지속성의 의미
det.tip: increasingly(점점 더) ↔ decreasingly(점점 줄어들며). -ingly 부사 형태

questions.passage:
(A) Agritourism activities can take <u>place</u> at times of the year when crops are not in season.

(B) Others may navigate a corn maze, stay on a farm, or help with farm chores. The farm is a peaceful <u>place</u> away from the busy city life.
questions.stem: 다음 (A)와 (B)의 밑줄 친 place의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) 농촌 체험 관광 활동이 일어날(take place) 수 있다. (B) 농장은 평화로운 장소(place)이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ (A) 발생하다 — (B) 장소: (A) 'take place' = 발생하다/일어나다. (B) 'a peaceful place' = 평화로운 장소
❌ ① (A) 장소: take place는 '발생하다'의 숙어
❌ ② 둘 다 발생하다: (B)는 명사 '장소'
❌ ④ 둘 다 장소: (A)는 take place 숙어의 일부
det.tip: take place = 발생하다, 일어나다 (place가 '장소'가 아님). place(명사) = 장소

questions.passage: Agritourism is an increasingly popular form of travel that allows tourists to experience rural life, connect with nature, and learn about the agricultural industry. It provides tourists with an amazing experience and a fun educational opportunity they cannot have in cities. It also gives valuable insights into the history and culture of farming and the importance of sustainable agriculture. Most tourists spend time visiting farm stands, picking fruit, or feeding animals.
questions.stem:
다음 영영 풀이에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

"able to continue over a period of time without causing damage to the environment"

det.korean: 환경에 피해를 주지 않으면서 오랜 기간 지속할 수 있는 = sustainable(지속 가능한)
det.analysis:
✅ ④ sustainable: 환경 친화적이고 장기 지속 가능한
❌ ① profitable(수익성 있는): 환경 관련이 아닌 수익 관련
❌ ② traditional(전통적인): 지속 가능성과 다른 의미
❌ ③ industrial(산업의): 환경 보호와 무관
det.tip: sustainable(지속 가능한) = sus(아래서) + tain(지탱하다) + able. sustainable agriculture = 지속 가능한 농업

questions.passage: Agritourism is an __________ (increase) popular form of travel that allows tourists to experience rural life. It provides tourists with an amazing experience they cannot have in cities.
questions.stem: 다음 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오.

det.analysis: __________ popular: 형용사 popular를 수식하려면 부사 필요. increase(동사) → increasingly(부사)
det.tip: increase(동사: 증가하다) → increasing(형용사) → increasingly(부사: 점점 더)

questions.passage: Some studies have found that agritourism operations also benefit the __________ (surround) communities by attracting tourists to the area. The economic boost from increased traffic can be good for the entire rural community.
questions.stem: 다음 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오.

det.analysis: the __________ communities: 명사 communities를 수식하려면 형용사 필요. surround(동사) → surrounding(형용사: 주변의)
det.tip: surround(동사: 둘러싸다) → surrounding(형용사: 주변의). surrounding communities = 주변 지역사회

questions.passage: Most tourists spend time visiting farm stands, picking fruit, or feeding animals. Others may navigate a corn maze, stay on a farm, or help with farm chores. In addition to providing fun activities for tourists, agritourism has become a necessary means of survival for many small farms today. This is because agritourism activities can take place at times of the year when __________. By adding new business operations, farm operators are able to ensure a stable income regardless of the seasons.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 농작물이 제철이 아닌(crops are not in season) 시기.
det.analysis:
✅ ① crops are not in season: 원문 일치. 비수확기에도 활동 가능하여 수입 확보
❌ ② tourists are not interested: 관광객이 관심 없다면 수입 확보 불가
❌ ③ farm animals are sleeping: 비논리적
❌ ④ the weather is too hot: 날씨와 직접 관련 없음
det.tip: in season = 제철인. not in season = 비수확기. 농촌 관광이 비수확기 수입원이 되는 이유

questions.passage: By adding new business operations, farm operators are able to ensure a stable income regardless of the seasons. Some studies have found that agritourism operations also benefit the surrounding communities by attracting tourists to the area. The economic boost from increased traffic can be good for __________. Agritourism activities can take place at times of the year when crops are not in season. This has made agritourism a necessary means of survival for many small farms.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: the tourists who visit the farms

det.korean: 농촌 지역사회 전체(the entire rural community)에 이익이 된다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ the entire rural community: 원문 일치. 농장뿐 아니라 주변 지역사회 전체에 경제적 이익
❌ ① only the farm operators: '주변 지역사회에도 이익'이므로 농장 운영자만은 아님
❌ ② the tourists: 관광객이 아닌 지역사회가 수혜자
❌ ③ the agricultural industry nationwide: 전국이 아닌 주변 지역사회
det.tip: entire(전체의) rural community(농촌 지역사회). surrounding communities에서 범위 확대
